item.title: HENDERSONVILLE DOCUMENT SHRED EVENT MAY 18TH
item.description: The City of Hendersonville will sponsor a Document Shred Event for City residents on Monday, May 18, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. This year’s event will be held in Patton Park located at 114 E. Clairmont Drive in Hendersonville. Shred-it will have its shredding truck at the Patton Pool parking lot to allow residents to dispose of sensitive materials.
